text: Castro Electrónica describes itself on its company page as a Portuguese electronics business founded in 1996 with wholly Portuguese capital ('capital 100% Português'); no parent company, fund or state owner is named anywhere on the site.
short: Castro Electrónica is a self-owned Portuguese company (capital 100% Portuguese, founded 1996).

source.name: Castro Electrónica: A Castro Electrónica (company page)
source.quote: Desde a sua criação em 1996, a Castro Electrónica tem servido a indústria e comércio do mercado da eletrónica em Portugal ... Uma empresa com capital 100% Português
